title: Example Tool
description: Minimal custom walkthrough example. Replace the public URLs, locators and verification signals with the tool you want to guide.

steps.title: Open the tool
steps.body: Control Walkthrough opens the exact public page and verifies the destination before continuing.

steps.title: Find the next control
steps.body: Use a stable selector or accessible/visible label. If several controls are equally plausible, Control Walkthrough should stop instead of guessing.
steps.humanGate: Enter credentials yourself. Do not place secrets inside a walkthrough file.

steps.title: Verify the signed-in surface
steps.body: Real walkthroughs should use a stable, non-sensitive signal that proves the expected state.

success.successMessage: The expected dashboard control is visible.
success.failureMessage: Dashboard not detected yet; finish sign-in manually and check again.
